tools.name: tablepredict_list_competitions
tools.description: List competitions currently configured in TablePredict, including season, prediction mode, roster size, cutoff, and predictor URL. Call this before requesting a roster or building a prediction link. Returns no user data.

tools.name: tablepredict_get_competition_teams
tools.description: Return the exact canonical club names for domestic leagues or national-team names for grouped tournaments. Grouped competitions preserve their official group membership. Use an id, route slug, or display name from tablepredict_list_competitions.

tools.name: tablepredict_build_prediction_link
tools.description: Validate a complete prediction and return a source-attributed TablePredict URL prefilled with that ranking. Domestic competitions require order; grouped competitions require every group. This tool does not save, publish, or create an account.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: tablepredict_list_competitions · Public sink: tablepredict_build_prediction_link.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: tablepredict_list_competitions · Public sink: tablepredict_build_prediction_link

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "tablepredict_list_competitions" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
